claims.object_text: MeCP2 is phosphorylated at serine 421 by MSK1 in MSNs via MAPK/ERK, independently of CaMKII, forming a nuclear complex and involved in transcriptional regulation
claims.quote: MSK1 drives BDNF-induced MeCP2 phosphorylation at serine 421 in MSNs via MAPK/ERK, independently of CaMKII, forming a nuclear complex with MeCP2, thus amplifying MSK1´s role in transcriptional regulation.

claims.object_text: MSK1-MeCP2 signalling is involved in BDNF-dependent and independent morphological developmental processes of cultured striatal neurons
claims.quote: This MSK1-MeCP2 signalling is also involved in BDNF-dependent and independent morphological developmental processes of cultured striatal neurons.

claims.object_text: MeCP2 deficiency is associated with dysregulated GABAergic (Gad1, Gabrg3) and dopaminergic (Drd1, Drd2, Drd3) gene expression
claims.quote: Msk1IV KO striatum shows dysregulated GABAergic (Gad1, Gabrg3) and dopaminergic (Drd1, Drd2, Drd3) gene expression, mirroring profiles in MeCP2 deficient models.
neurodevelopmental and psychiatric disorders, including those associated with MeCP2 dysfunction.
